blocks.zh: Section 1: Sterilization Methods & Selection — 滅菌方法與選擇
blocks.en: Section 1: Sterilization Methods & Selection

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解容器密封系統（Container-Closure System）在無菌保證中的關鍵角色與選擇標準
blocks.en: Understand the critical role of the container-closure system in sterility assurance and the criteria for selecting it

blocks.zh: 區分去污染（Decontamination）與滅菌（Sterilization）的定義與適用場景
blocks.en: Distinguish the definitions and applications of decontamination and sterilization

blocks.zh: 理解去熱原（Depyrogenation）在注射劑生產中的必要性
blocks.en: Understand why depyrogenation is necessary in injectable manufacturing

blocks.zh: 掌握無菌製造設備的三個影響層級：直接接觸、間接接觸、其他設備
blocks.en: Grasp the three levels of impact of aseptic manufacturing equipment: direct product contact, indirect product contact, and other equipment

blocks.zh: 認識不同製造環境（潔淨室、RABS、隔離器、BFS、封閉系統）的分類與適用情境
blocks.en: Recognize the classification and suitable use of the different manufacturing environments (cleanrooms, RABS, isolators, BFS, closed systems)

blocks.zh: 理解參數放行（Parametric Release）作為終端滅菌產品的預設放行模式
blocks.en: Understand parametric release as the default release mode for terminally sterilized products

blocks.zh: Containers and Closures — 容器與封蓋
blocks.en: Containers and Closures

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 容器封蓋系統的雙重角色
blocks.en: Key Concept — The Dual Role of the Container-Closure System

blocks.zh: 容器封蓋系統不僅是「裝藥品的瓶子」，它是無菌產品的一部分。它必須同時滿足：
blocks.en: The container-closure system is not just "the bottle that holds the drug"; it is part of the sterile product. It must satisfy all of the following at the same time:

blocks.zh: 保護功能：在整個貨架壽命期間維持無菌狀態（Container-Closure Integrity, CCI）
blocks.en: Protective function: maintain sterility throughout the shelf life (Container-Closure Integrity, CCI)

blocks.zh: 惰性要求：不與藥品發生化學反應（可溶出物/可提取物 E&L）
blocks.en: Inertness: no chemical reaction with the drug product (extractables and leachables, E&L)

blocks.zh: 製程相容性：能夠承受滅菌和去熱原處理的條件
blocks.en: Process compatibility: able to withstand the conditions of sterilization and depyrogenation

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — CDMO 容器選擇策略
blocks.en: Key Point — Container Selection Strategy for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，容器選擇是一個需要平衡多方需求的決策：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, container selection is a decision that has to balance several competing needs:

blocks.zh: 客戶指定 vs 內部標準化：不同客戶可能指定不同的容器供應商，但 CDMO 應建立經過驗證的標準容器組合
blocks.en: Customer-specified vs. internal standardization: different customers may specify different container suppliers, but the CDMO should establish validated standard container combinations

blocks.zh: CCI 驗證：必須涵蓋整個貨架壽命，包括運輸振動、溫度變化等挑戰條件
blocks.en: CCI validation: must cover the entire shelf life, including challenge conditions such as transport vibration and temperature changes

blocks.zh: E&L 評估：需要在產品開發早期就開始，避免後期發現不相容問題
blocks.en: E&L assessment: needs to start early in product development, to avoid finding incompatibility problems late

blocks.zh: Decontamination — 去污染
blocks.en: Decontamination

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 殺芽孢劑的實務考量
blocks.en: Key Point — Practical Considerations for Sporicidal Agents

blocks.zh: 殺芽孢劑（如 VHP、過氧乙酸）雖然效力強，但有兩個限制：
blocks.en: Sporicidal agents (such as VHP and peracetic acid) are highly effective, but they have two limitations:

blocks.zh: 人員毒性：操作人員需要適當防護或等待殘留濃度降低
blocks.en: Operator toxicity: operators need appropriate protection or must wait until residual concentrations fall

blocks.zh: 材質腐蝕：長期使用可能損害設備表面
blocks.en: Material corrosion: long-term use may damage equipment surfaces

blocks.zh: 因此實務上採用「輪替策略」— 以非殺芽孢劑為常規使用，定期（如每週一次）使用殺芽孢劑來控制芽孢菌群。
blocks.en: In practice, therefore, a "rotation strategy" is used: a non-sporicidal agent for routine use, with a sporicidal agent applied periodically (for example, once a week) to control the spore-forming flora.

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 去污染 vs 滅菌
blocks.en: Key Concept — Decontamination vs. Sterilization

blocks.zh: USP〈1211〉明確區分了兩個經常被混淆的概念：
blocks.en: USP <1211> clearly distinguishes two concepts that are often confused:

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：能滅菌就不要只做去污染。去污染是「不得已的備案」，不是「偷懶的選擇」。
blocks.en: Key principle: if you can sterilize, do not settle for decontamination alone. Decontamination is a "fallback when there is no alternative", not an "easy way out".

blocks.zh: Equipment — 設備
blocks.en: Equipment

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 設備影響三層級
blocks.en: Key Concept — Three Levels of Equipment Impact

blocks.zh: USP 將設備依其對產品品質的影響分為三個層級，每個層級有不同的驗證和維護要求：
blocks.en: USP classifies equipment into three levels according to its impact on product quality, and each level has different validation and maintenance requirements:

blocks.zh: 直接接觸設備 — 最嚴格要求
blocks.en: Direct product-contact equipment — most stringent requirements

blocks.zh: 間接接觸設備 — 中等要求
blocks.en: Indirect product-contact equipment — moderate requirements

blocks.zh: 其他設備 — 基本要求
blocks.en: Other equipment — basic requirements

blocks.zh: 直接接觸設備的清潔和滅菌驗證必須包含三個保持時間：髒污保持時間（dirty hold）、清潔保持時間（clean hold）、無菌保持時間（sterile hold）。
blocks.en: Cleaning and sterilization validation for direct product-contact equipment must include three hold times: dirty hold time, clean hold time, and sterile hold time.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 拋棄式設備的興起
blocks.en: Key Point — The Rise of Single-Use Equipment

blocks.zh: USP〈1211〉提到「適當考慮材質相容性後，可以使用拋棄式設備（Single-Use Disposable Equipment）」。這反映了產業趨勢：
blocks.en: USP <1211> notes that "single-use disposable equipment can be used with appropriate consideration of material compatibility". This reflects an industry trend:

blocks.zh: 拋棄式設備消除了清潔驗證和交叉污染的風險
blocks.en: Single-use equipment removes the cleaning validation and cross-contamination risks

blocks.zh: 特別適合 CDMO 多產品、小批量的營運模式
blocks.en: Particularly well suited to the multi-product, small-batch operating model of a CDMO

blocks.zh: 但需要進行可提取物/可溶出物（E&L）評估
blocks.en: However, an extractables and leachables (E&L) assessment is still needed

blocks.zh: Facilities — 設施
blocks.en: Facilities

blocks.zh: *CNC = Controlled Non-Classified — 受控但未分級環境，有過濾空氣供應
blocks.en: *CNC = Controlled Non-Classified: a controlled but unclassified environment with a filtered air supply

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 從開放到封閉的進化路徑
blocks.en: Key Concept — The Evolution from Open to Closed

blocks.zh: USP〈1211〉的 Table 1 揭示了無菌製造技術的進化趨勢 — 從傳統潔淨室到封閉系統，人與產品之間的隔離程度不斷提升：
blocks.en: Table 1 of USP <1211> shows the evolution of aseptic manufacturing technology: from conventional cleanrooms to closed systems, the degree of separation between people and product keeps increasing:

blocks.zh: 傳統潔淨室：人在 ISO 5 區域內操作，風險最高
blocks.en: Conventional cleanroom: personnel work inside the ISO 5 area, which carries the highest risk

blocks.zh: Open RABS：有物理屏障但可打開，中等隔離
blocks.en: Open RABS: has a physical barrier but can be opened; moderate separation

blocks.zh: Closed RABS：更高程度隔離，手套操作
blocks.en: Closed RABS: a higher degree of separation, with glove-port operation

blocks.zh: 隔離器：完全隔離，背景環境可降至 CNC
blocks.en: Isolator: complete separation; the background environment can be reduced to CNC

blocks.zh: 封閉系統：無需製程環境分級，最高隔離
blocks.en: Closed system: no classification of the process environment is needed; highest separation

blocks.zh: 注意：背景環境等級隨著隔離程度提升而降低。這就是隔離技術的核心價值 — 降低對背景環境的依賴。
blocks.en: Note that the background environment grade drops as the degree of separation rises. This is the core value of barrier technology: less dependence on the background environment.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 太空人 vs 實驗室：傳統潔淨室就像穿著防護衣在開放實驗室工作 — 你的防護衣再好，人體散發的微粒仍會影響周圍環境。隔離器就像太空艙 — 太空人完全在密封環境中操作，外面的環境好壞不影響內部。封閉系統更進一步 — 連太空人都不需要了，全自動運行。
blocks.en: Astronaut vs. laboratory: a conventional cleanroom is like working in an open laboratory in protective clothing: however good the clothing, the particles the body sheds still affect the surroundings. An isolator is like a space capsule: the astronaut works entirely inside a sealed environment, and the conditions outside do not affect the inside. A closed system goes a step further: there is no astronaut at all, and everything runs automatically.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — RABS 中途開啟的陷阱
blocks.en: Key Point — The Trap of Opening a RABS During Processing

blocks.zh: USP〈1211〉明確指出：製程中途開啟的 RABS 應被視為傳統潔淨室。這是一個經常被忽略的規則 — 如果你的 RABS 設計允許中途開啟進行人工介入，它就失去了隔離技術的優勢，必須按照開放式潔淨室的標準進行環境控制和監控。
blocks.en: USP <1211> states explicitly that a RABS that is opened during the process should be treated as a conventional cleanroom. This rule is often overlooked: if your RABS design allows it to be opened mid-process for manual intervention, it loses the advantage of barrier technology and must be controlled and monitored to the standard of an open cleanroom.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 工廠目前使用哪種製造技術？參照 USP Table 1，你的背景環境等級是否符合要求？
blocks.en: Which manufacturing technology does your CDMO site currently use? Referring to USP Table 1, does your background environment grade meet the requirement?

blocks.zh: 如果客戶要求從傳統潔淨室升級到隔離器，這會對你的環境監控程式產生什麼影響？監測點數量和頻率會如何調整？
blocks.en: If a customer asks you to upgrade from a conventional cleanroom to an isolator, how would this affect your environmental monitoring program? How would the number and frequency of monitoring locations change?

blocks.zh: USP 說「人是最大的微生物風險源」。在你的工廠中，有哪些具體的人員介入操作可以透過自動化來消除？
blocks.en: USP says that "people are the greatest source of microbial risk". In your facility, which specific human interventions could be eliminated through automation?

blocks.zh: Materials — 物料
blocks.en: Materials

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 生物負載控制鏈
blocks.en: Key Concept — The Bioburden Control Chain

blocks.zh: USP〈1211〉建立了一個從供應商到成品的完整生物負載控制鏈：
blocks.en: USP <1211> establishes a complete bioburden control chain from supplier to finished product:

blocks.zh: 供應商控制：原料的微生物品質從源頭管理
blocks.en: Supplier control: manage the microbiological quality of raw materials at the source

blocks.zh: 運輸與接收：確保運輸條件不導致微生物增殖
blocks.en: Transport and receipt: ensure that transport conditions do not allow microbial proliferation

blocks.zh: 取樣與檢驗：依據 USP〈61〉/〈62〉進行微生物限度檢查
blocks.en: Sampling and testing: perform microbial limits testing according to USP <61>/<62>

blocks.zh: 儲存管理：控制溫度、濕度等條件防止微生物生長
blocks.en: Storage management: control conditions such as temperature and humidity to prevent microbial growth

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 檢驗結果不能為供應商的失控辯護
blocks.en: Key Point — Test Results Cannot Excuse a Supplier's Loss of Control

blocks.zh: USP 的這句話直指一個常見問題：有些公司在收到微生物超標的原料時，會用「最終產品檢驗合格」來合理化接受。USP 明確否定這種做法 — 供應商的製程控制是獨立的品質要求，不能用下游的檢驗結果來取代。
blocks.en: This statement in USP goes straight to a common problem: when a company receives raw material that exceeds its microbial limits, it sometimes justifies accepting it because "the final product passed testing". USP explicitly rejects this practice: the supplier's process control is an independent quality requirement and cannot be replaced by downstream test results.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這意味著需要建立健全的供應商稽核和合格供應商清單（Approved Supplier List）制度。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means establishing a robust supplier audit program and an Approved Supplier List.

blocks.zh: Sterilization & Parametric Release — 滅菌與參數放行
blocks.en: Sterilization & Parametric Release

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 參數放行是預設模式
blocks.en: Key Concept — Parametric Release Is the Default Mode

blocks.zh: USP〈1211〉做出了一個重要聲明：參數放行（Parametric Release）是終端滅菌產品的預設放行模式。這意味著：
blocks.en: USP <1211> makes an important statement: parametric release is the default release mode for terminally sterilized products. This means:

blocks.zh: 對於終端滅菌產品，理想情況下不需要進行無菌試驗〈71〉
blocks.en: For a terminally sterilized product, ideally no sterility test <71> is needed

blocks.zh: 放行依據是滅菌製程的物理參數（溫度、時間、壓力等）是否在驗證的範圍內
blocks.en: Release is based on whether the physical parameters of the sterilization process (temperature, time, pressure, etc.) are within the validated range

blocks.zh: 前提是滅菌製程已經過充分驗證，且有持續的過程監控
blocks.en: The precondition is that the sterilization process is fully validated and subject to ongoing process monitoring

blocks.zh: 這是一個理念上的重大轉變 — 從「靠測試放行」轉向「靠製程控制放行」。
blocks.en: This is a major shift in philosophy: from "release by testing" to "release by process control".

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 參數放行的實施門檻
blocks.en: Key Point — The Threshold for Implementing Parametric Release

blocks.zh: 雖然 USP 將參數放行定位為「預設模式」，但在實務中，很多市場（特別是某些亞太地區法規市場）對參數放行的核准門檻較高。CDMO 在評估是否實施參數放行時需要考慮：
blocks.en: Although USP positions parametric release as the "default mode", in practice many markets (especially some Asia-Pacific regulatory markets) set a higher bar for approving it. When evaluating whether to implement parametric release, a CDMO needs to consider:

blocks.zh: 所有目標法規市場是否都接受參數放行
blocks.en: Whether all target regulatory markets accept parametric release

blocks.zh: 滅菌製程的驗證是否足夠全面
blocks.en: Whether the validation of the sterilization process is sufficiently comprehensive

blocks.zh: 持續監控系統是否可靠
blocks.en: Whether the ongoing monitoring system is reliable

blocks.zh: 變更控制是否完善
blocks.en: Whether change control is robust

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 容器封蓋系統：是無菌產品不可分割的一部分，選擇標準涵蓋 CCI、材質相容性、E&L、內毒素控制等九項要素
blocks.en: Container-closure system: an integral part of the sterile product; selection criteria cover nine elements including CCI, material compatibility, E&L, and endotoxin control

blocks.zh: 去污染 ≠ 滅菌：去污染僅降低微生物數量，不期待完全殺滅。能滅菌的場景不應只做去污染
blocks.en: Decontamination is not sterilization: decontamination only reduces the number of microorganisms and is not expected to kill them all. Where sterilization is possible, decontamination alone should not be used

blocks.zh: 設備三層級：直接接觸（最嚴格）→ 間接接觸 → 其他設備，驗證要求依層級遞減
blocks.en: Three levels of equipment: direct contact (most stringent) → indirect contact → other equipment; validation requirements decrease with each level

blocks.zh: 製造環境進化：傳統潔淨室 → RABS → 隔離器 → 封閉系統，人與產品的隔離程度持續提升
blocks.en: Evolution of manufacturing environments: conventional cleanroom → RABS → isolator → closed system, with an ever greater degree of separation between people and product

blocks.zh: 人員風險：USP 再次強調人是最大微生物風險源，驅動自動化和隔離技術的採用
blocks.en: Personnel risk: USP again stresses that people are the greatest source of microbial risk, which drives the adoption of automation and barrier technology

blocks.zh: 物料控制：從供應商到儲存的全鏈條生物負載管理，檢驗結果不能為供應商失控辯護
blocks.en: Material control: bioburden management across the whole chain from supplier to storage; test results cannot excuse a supplier's loss of control

blocks.zh: 參數放行：USP 定位為終端滅菌的「預設放行模式」— 從「靠測試」轉向「靠製程控制」
blocks.en: Parametric release: USP positions it as the "default release mode" for terminal sterilization, a shift from "relying on testing" to "relying on process control"
